xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnMeetingOfCo: In the absence of Independent Directors which form the quorum, the Board of Directors in its meeting held on 28.1.2025 have resolved that no meeting of Board Sub-Committee shall be conducted until the appointment of Independent Directors by Govt. of India. xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfNonComplianceOfQuorum: In the absence of Independent Directors on the Board of the Company from 08.11.2024 to 27.03.2025, the requirement of presence of one Independent Director to form the quorum as prescribed in the Listing Regulations were not met in Two Board Meetings conducted during the quaretr on 28.1.2025 & 10.2.205 respectively.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfNonComplianceOfMeetin: In the absence of Independent Directors on the Board of the Company from 08.11.2024 to 27.03.2025, the Board of Directors have resolved no meeting of Board Sub-Committee to be conducted in the absence of valid quorum.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfNonComplianceOfGapBet: In the absence of Independent Directors on the Board of the Company from 08.11.2024 to 27.03.2025, as decided by Board no meeting were conducted. Hence, gap between the meetings of Risk Management Committee could not be maintained.
